name: mediscribe-desktop
description: MediScribe Desktop - Local-first medical lecture transcription

scripts.build:backend: echo 'Backend uses Python - no build step needed'
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron && npm run build:backend
scripts.package: npm run build:all && cd electron && npm run package
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:all && cd electron && npm run package:linux
scripts.postinstall: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../electron && npm install
